subject: Assertion & provisioning audit delivery plan
messages:
From: AskTeam Audit <askteam-audit@apex-audit.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Initial IA request — SAML assertions, SCIM deltas and role owners (CardioHealth)

Mateo / Irene,

We're kicking off our access-control evidence collection for CardioHealth's SIG/SOC2 review. For scope: we need a short sample set and a delivery plan for the following artifacts covering the period 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-30:

- Representative SAML assertion samples (including NameID, audience, and assertion timestamps)
- SCIM provisioning delta log (add/modify/deprovision events)
- Current RBAC role-owner roster and evidence of role assignment changes in the period

If possible, please provide a short timeline (delivery dates) and indicate any redaction or export caveats. We can accept pseudonymized values for PII fields.

Thanks,
Jennifer Li
Lead Auditor, Apex Audit
jennifer.li@cardiohealth.co

--
Attachment: evidence-request-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Initial IA request — SAML assertions, SCIM deltas and role owners (CardioHealth)

Folks — forwarding the Apex audit ask. Short ask: can we pull a concise package (samples + a short write-up) by next Tuesday? Key constraints: SCIM exports need to be reconciled with tenant snapshots, and SAML traces are stored in the auth cluster with rotation keys; we may need a short statement about key rotation windows.

Irene — can you lead the SAML/SCIM extracts? Vanessa — can you assemble RBAC owner roster and any change tickets? Sean — please flag any SLA-impacting ops steps for export.

I'll own delivery and external coordination.

Thanks,
Mateo
Product Security Liaison | Redwood Inference
--
Internal note: target delivery 2026-11-30 for samples, full artifacts by 2026-12-01

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Initial IA request — SAML assertions, SCIM deltas and role owners (CardioHealth)

Mateo — starting extracts. Quick notes:

1) SAML assertion storage: we can pull a 72-hour sampling window from the auth cluster for the requested period; full assertion dumps are sizable due to replay logs. I'll provide 5 representative assertions that include encrypted NameID redacted, Audience, IssueInstant, and SubjectConfirmation data.

2) SCIM deltas: our provisioning service logs SCIM PATCH/POST/DELETE events to the tenant-change stream. I'll export a delta CSV (account_id, action, timestamp, actor_id, attribute_changed) and include a small reconciliation script note.

3) Key rotation: we rotated assertion-signing key on 2026-11-10 (rolling), will include a short attestation note and KMS key-id references (no key material).

I'll attach preliminary saml-assertion-samples_20261127.log and scim-delta-20261130.csv for initial review.

Irene Choi
Identity & Access Engineer | Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: saml-assertion-samples_20261127.log (text), scim-delta-20261130.csv (csv)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Initial IA request — SAML assertions, SCIM deltas and role owners (CardioHealth)

Attached the RBAC owner roster and short comments on change records. A few points to call out:

- Role "platform-admin" has three claimed owners; two are service accounts that will require justification. I've flagged the change tickets (CHG-5482, CHG-5517).
- We retain role assignment audit entries in the entitlement store; export format is CSV and can be redacted for user email addresses per policy.

I've attached rbac-owner-roster_20261129.pdf and included a short CSV extract if they prefer machine-readable.

Vanessa Ortiz
Technical Program Manager, Customer Security

--
Attachments: rbac-owner-roster_20261129.pdf (pdf)

From: AskTeam Audit <askteam-audit@apex-audit.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jennifer Li <jennifer.li@cardiohealth.co>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial IA request — SAML assertions, SCIM deltas and role owners (CardioHealth)

Thanks for the quick turn. We received the saml and RBAC PDFs — initial check looks good. Two requests before final delivery:

1) Can you include one example where NameID was pseudonymized, and show the mapping table separately (redacted) so we can validate it lines up with account IDs?
2) Please provide a signed attestation (PDF) from Redwoods' security lead stating the exports are complete and unmodified. A simple "we attest" statement with the date and signer is fine.

If you can put the attest + SCIM full delta in a shared Drive link by EOD 2026-12-01, we can close evidence collection for this control.

Best,
Jennifer Li
Apex Audit

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: AskTeam Audit <askteam-audit@apex-audit.com>, Jennifer Li <jennifer.li@cardiohealth.co>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2026 15:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial IA request — SAML assertions, SCIM deltas and role owners (CardioHealth)

Jennifer — attaching the final artifacts to the shared drive and the signed attestation. Summary of deliverables:

- Drive folder: https://drive.redwood/g/cardio-soc2/iam-evidence-2026 (internal link, shared with apex-audit)
- saml-assertion-samples_20261127.log (5 assertions; NameID pseudonymized; mapping table attached as scim-id-mapping_20261130.csv, PII redacted)
- scim-delta-20261130.csv (full delta, add/modify/remove; includes actor_id mapped to pseudonymous account ids)
- rbac-owner-roster_20261129.pdf
- signed-attestation-matrix_20261201.pdf (signed by Priya Natarajan, Head of Security Compliance)

Note: as discussed, the saml logs are exported from the auth cluster and have been redacted to remove IPs and full NameIDs; we included KMS key-ids for the 2026-11-10 rotation in the attestation. If Apex needs device-level IP traces or full unredacted NameIDs for a regulator, please coordinate with our legal team (cc'd in separate thread).

Let me know if anything else is required. Thanks for the productive coordination.

Mateo Alvarez
Product Security Liaison | Redwood Inference
--
Attachments: signed-attestation-matrix_20261201.pdf (pdf); scim-id-mapping_20261130.csv (csv)
